extensions.name: Paper Statements
extensions.description: The statements journals now require: data and code availability, author contributions (CRediT), funding, conflicts and ethics, plus a reproducibility checklist.
extensions.author: LatexDo

snippets.label: dataavailability
snippets.insertText:
\\section*{Data Availability\}
The data supporting this study are openly available in ${1:Repository} at \\url{${2:https://doi.org/...}\} under the ${3:CC BY 4.0} licence.
snippets.documentation: States where the data can be found and under which licence.

snippets.label: codeavailability
snippets.insertText:
\\section*{Code Availability\}
The code used in this study is available at \\url{${1:https://github.com/...}\} and archived at \\url{${2:https://doi.org/...}\} (version ${3:1.0}).
snippets.documentation: Points to the archived code release.

snippets.label: credit
snippets.documentation: Contributions using the CRediT taxonomy roles.

snippets.label: funding
snippets.insertText:
\\section*{Funding\}
This work was supported by ${1:Funder} under grant ${2:number}. The funder had no role in study design, data collection, analysis or the decision to publish.
snippets.documentation: Grant numbers and funders.

snippets.label: conflicts
snippets.insertText:
\\section*{Competing Interests\}
The authors declare ${1:no competing interests}.
snippets.documentation: Declares (no) competing interests.

snippets.label: ethics
snippets.insertText:
\\section*{Ethics Statement\}
This study was approved by ${1:the ethics committee of University} (approval ${2:number}). ${3:All participants gave informed consent.}
snippets.documentation: Approval and consent for human or animal studies.

snippets.label: artifactchecklist
snippets.insertText:
\\paragraph{Reproducibility.\}
Code and data are available at ${1:URL}. Experiments use random seeds ${2:0--4} and ran on ${3:hardware}; each run took about ${4:time}. Hyperparameters are listed in ${5:Appendix~\\ref{app:hyper\}}.
snippets.documentation: A short paragraph covering code, data, seeds and hardware.

extensions.name: Review and Revision
extensions.description: Tools for co-writing and revising: visible added, deleted and replaced text, to-do notes, placeholder figures and reviewer response blocks.
extensions.author: LatexDo

snippets.label: changessetup
snippets.documentation: Marks edits in colour; use the final option to hide them for submission. Needs changes.

snippets.label: added
snippets.documentation: Shows new text in colour while in draft mode.

snippets.label: deleted
snippets.documentation: Shows removed text struck through.

snippets.label: replaced
snippets.documentation: Shows the new and old wording.

snippets.label: todo
snippets.documentation: A margin note for co-authors. Needs todonotes.

snippets.label: inlinetodo
snippets.documentation: A to-do inside the text. Needs todonotes.

snippets.label: missingfigure
snippets.documentation: A box that marks a figure still to be made. Needs todonotes.

snippets.label: reviewresponse
snippets.documentation: A reviewer comment followed by the response.

snippets.label: revisionnote
snippets.insertText:
\\paragraph{Change made.\}
We updated ${1:Section~\\ref{sec:method\}} to ${0:describe the revision}.
snippets.documentation: A short summary of a change.
